# About cache settings

Several settings shape how the cache behaves over time.

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| size | 256 | entries |
| ttl | 300 | seconds |
| shards | 4 | partitions |
| policy | lru | eviction |
| warm | false | preload |
| stats | true | metrics |
